+from marshmallow import EXCLUDE, Schema, fields
+
+
+class SelectionLeaf(Schema):
+    name = fields.Str()
+    age = fields.Int()
+    city = fields.Str()
+
+
+class SelectionBatch(Schema):
+    pair = fields.Tuple((fields.Nested(SelectionLeaf, only=("name", "age")), fields.Nested(SelectionLeaf)))
+    wrapped = fields.List(fields.Dict(keys=fields.Str(), values=fields.Tuple((fields.Nested(SelectionLeaf),))))
+    scalar = fields.Tuple((fields.Int(),))
+
+
+PAIR = ({"name": "A", "age": 7, "city": "X"}, {"name": "B", "age": 8, "city": "Y"})
+
+
+def test_tuple_only_and_loading():
+    schema = SelectionBatch(only=("pair.age",))
+    assert schema.dump({"pair": PAIR}) == {"pair": ({"age": 7}, {"age": 8})}
+    assert schema.load({"pair": [{"age": "7"}, {"age": "8"}]}) == {"pair": ({"age": 7}, {"age": 8})}
+
+
+def test_tuple_exclude_preserves_child_only():
+    schema = SelectionBatch(exclude=("pair.age",))
+    assert schema.dump({"pair": PAIR}) == {"pair": ({"name": "A"}, {"name": "B", "city": "Y"})}
+
+
+def test_deep_wrappers_and_instance_isolation():
+    payload = {"wrapped": [{"slot": (PAIR[0],)}], "scalar": (3,)}
+    first = SelectionBatch(only=("wrapped.age", "scalar"))
+    second = SelectionBatch(only=("wrapped.name",))
+    assert first.dump(payload) == {"wrapped": [{"slot": ({"age": 7},)}], "scalar": (3,)}
+    assert second.dump(payload) == {"wrapped": [{"slot": ({"name": "A"},)}]}
+    assert first.load({"wrapped": [{"slot": [{"age": "7"}]}], "scalar": ["3"]}, unknown=EXCLUDE) == {"wrapped": [{"slot": ({"age": 7},)}], "scalar": (3,)}
+    assert SelectionBatch(exclude=("wrapped.age",)).dump(payload) == {"wrapped": [{"slot": ({"name": "A", "city": "X"},)}], "scalar": (3,)}
